Source notices retained from wide-1.7.1

Each section reproduces an entire source comment block without shortening its license terms.
Identical blocks are collected once, with every matching source location listed below.
Locations include tests/benches where present; their inclusion does not assert runtime linkage.
The added headings and source locations are collection metadata, not changes to upstream notices.
